item.title: Author shows storytelling's impact on leadership success
item.description: Storytelling can be a powerful tool to build connection and drive business performance, according to Danielle Krischik, creator and author of "The Story Effect".

item.title: 2026 marketing trends: Why SEO is not enough
item.description: Businesses in 2026 must focus on trust and proof signals, integrated AI systems, and customer experience to succeed in the credibility-first era of marketing.

item.title: 3 Texas spots named among top 'micro-escapes' in U.S.
item.description: Three Texas parks were ranked among the most restorative urban green spaces in the country, according to a survey.

item.title: Flying Fish seafood restaurant opens on Preston Road
item.description: Flying Fish, a fast-casual seafood restaurant, has opened its 12th location at 4032 Preston Road, featuring grilled seafood plates, Southern specialties, and daily specials.

item.title: Soy Cowboy serves trackside dining with IndyCar views in Arlington
item.description: Soy Cowboy in Arlington is offering trackside dining experiences during the IndyCar race weekend from March 13-15, for fans to view the race from its patio and VIP booths.

item.title: Streaming dominates: 70% of Americans favor it over cable TV
item.description: Streaming has become the primary way Americans watch video and engage with brands, with over 70% of adults now identifying streaming as their default viewing method and households subscribing to an average of 3.5 paid streaming services and 3.3 free ad-supported platforms.

item.title: Lowe's launches $100 million initiative for community projects
item.description: Lowe's is accepting nominations for its Community Bucket List program, which will fund up to 100 large-scale renovation projects and 2,000 smaller improvement projects to benefit schools, nonprofits, and first responder facilities.

item.title: Kind Snacks & Rob Rausch offer free breakfast giveaway
item.description: KIND Snacks has partnered with Rob Rausch to launch a limited-edition "RISE & KIND Breakfast Box" giveaway, featuring protein-heavy breakfast items inspired by Rausch's morning ritual.

item.title: Asador Dallas offers upscale Easter brunch with fresh flavors
item.description: Asador Dallas will host a farm-to-fire Easter brunch on April 5th, featuring a seasonal buffet with locally sourced ingredients, chef-attended stations, and house-made desserts, with prices at $95 for adults and $40 for children ages 6-12.

item.title: M&M's flavor vote returns with new bakery collection
item.description: M&M's is relaunching its Flavor Vote competition after seven years, with consumers able to vote for their favorite flavor from the new Bakery Collection until May 15.
